_note: Starting rules from quality-gates-plan.md. None is confirmed with Ted yet, so violations report as warn ('unconfirmed rule') and never fail. Set confirmed:true per rule once agreed. Globs: ** any depth, * within one segment, paths repo-relative. 'to' is matched against the resolved import path (alias-expanded) or the raw specifier for packages.

rules.description: The engine (src/engine, excluding ootk) never imports plugins.
Plugins (plugins and plugins-pro) reach the app only through the plugin API (src/plugin-api). Imports of src/app and src/engine are violations.
